verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-run sync outcome reporting, a sync-run debugger for rejected rows, and configurable alerts when a run fails. Because each sync targets one destination, this supports diagnosing delivery failures per destination; a company-sourced HN comment also cites a live debugger and alerting. However, nothing in the evidence shows a live view of Hightouch Events flowing in real time, and delivery metrics are only implied by run reports. Missing for 10: live event-stream debugger for collected events, documented per-destination delivery metrics/dashboards, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting
